title: Vocabulary-size-independent Convergence of Discrete Diffusion Models: adjoint equations induce the right space
summary: Discrete diffusion has become a leading framework for generative modeling in various applications including language, vision, and biology. Existing convergence theory, however, exhibits fundamental limitations. KL-based analyses diverge under singular priors such as the masked distribution, while bounds in total variation (TV) depend on the vocabulary size $S$ and become vacuous for modern language tasks, where vocabularies contain hundreds of thousands of tokens.
